segments.text: What is up developers? Welcome back to GitHub awesome. Today we're diving into GitHub trending skills number two. 35
open source Claude code skills trending on GitHub right now. Let's get into it.
Claude can read web pages and code bases but can't watch videos. Claude-vide changes that. Install it as a custom
skill. paste a YouTube link or local file path and the skill automatically downloads the video, extracts frames at an autoscaled rate, pulls the timestamp transcript, and hands it all to Claude.
By the time the AI answers you, it has literally watched the video and heard the audio.
AI written documentation is recognizable the moment you read it. Writing MD is a single markdown rule file you drop into
your project route. It forces the AI to use concise humanlike phrasing and eliminates filler words like delve into,
crucial, and inconclusion. Senior developer voice enforced by a text file.
Claude code builds functional UIs that all look identical by default. The fancy I official skills repository is a
focused pack of agent skills for premium UI generation. Load it and your agent understands how to implement frame or motion animations, balanced glass
morphism, and Apple style scroll effects correctly. A front-end design education for your AI in one skills install.
Reading an ery of paper and actually implementing it are two completely different problems. Paper 2 code takes a research paper PDF, reads the
methodology, extracts the math, and translates it directly into executable, heavily commented pietorch code.
Bleeding edge AI research running on your own hardware without the implementation work. The gap between understanding a paper and testing it closed.
Writing system prompts from scratch is exhausting. Garden skills is a curated collection of production ready skills
for claw code and codecs. Standout entries include a web design engineer built around anthropics cla philosophy
with strict color theory and anti-cliche rules. a rag skill that constrains retrieval to precise offset and limit
windows and a GPT image 2 skill with 70 plus structured prompt templates.
Charlie Hills 350K followers, 100 me views, just open sourced his entire content system as 17 clawed code skills.
A voice builder interviews you and captures your exact tone in a persistent file. From there, content matrix generation, historical post analysis to
grade new drafts, infographic and thumbnail creation, your content system built around your actual voice.
Most Claude code prompts are kitchen sync files that give the AI too much room to overthink. Matt PCO's skills
repo is the opposite. Small, sharp, singlepurpose primitives for TDD, GitHub triage, and breaking architecture into
vertical slices. Controlled vocabulary via language.mmd that defines exact architectural terms with strict warnings
preventing synonym substitution forces the AI to act like a precision tool, not a rambling chatbot.
Oh my design is a library of design files extracted from 67 realworldclass company design systems. Drop one into
your repo. Your agent instantly scaffolds components with pixel perfect consistency. Instead of just hex codes and font sizes, it injects deep brand
context and mood so your AI actually understands the vibe of the brand you're replicating.
Skill Doctor is a local first agent skill checker that autonomously scans your skills directory for overlapping prompts, conflicting priorities, and
security risks, analyzes every installed skill, flags redundancies, and helps you prioritize so your agent doesn't get
confused and hallucinate. Built with Typescript runs entirely locally so your proprietary prompts stay private.
Juggling clawed code, cursor, Gemini CLI, and codecs means messy unsynced rules everywhere. Skills manage is a
desktop app built with Tori stores skills in one central directory and uses SIM links to deploy them to 27 platforms simultaneously. built-in marketplace
with 2500 plus skills, GitHub import wizard, and a discover scanner that finds project level skills hiding on your machine.
If you want your Claude Code CLI to act less like a chat window and more like a 247 operating system, you need this
starter kit. It packages a highly opinionated 3M framework, mindset, method, machine directly into your
agents skills. It transforms Claude into a persistent automation layer that actively audits your tasks, manages your
daily routines, and acts as a continuous background operator while you are away from the desk.
Tech skill autonomously performs a thorough file-sighted technical debt audit, detects your stack, and natively runs the right static analysis tools.
Nip and match for TypeScript rough for Python. Cargo audit for Rust. Folding hardf facts directly into the report.
Evaluates code across nine critical dimensions. Outputs a persistent citable tech deck audit.md that updates stale issues and marks fixed ones as resolved.
Generating a single AI sprite is easy.
Generating an entire animated sprite sheet without flicker, size changes, or jitter is a nightmare. Sprite pipeline
is an end-to-end 2D sprite sheet creation pipeline. Takes raw AI generated frames, normalizes background
colors, removes visual artifacts, and mathematically align frames to eliminate animation jitter. Turns messy AI output
into stable productionready sheets you drop directly into Unity or Godo.
AI agents are trained on older code, so they hallucinate deprecated APIs when libraries ship new syntax. Library
skills lets library authors embed official agent skills directly inside their npm or Python packages. One CLI
command sim links the official skills for your installed libraries intocloud/skills perfectly synced to your exact version.
Web design forces your assistant into a strict spec first code second workflow.
Feed it a PRD reference URL rough sketch or just keywords. The agent generates a nine section designd locking down
typography, motion, layout, color, and accessibility before writing a line of code. Approve the spec, then it generates HTML, CSS, and JS strictly
adhering to it. Self audits against a 100point checklist.
Agent style is a drop-in technical pros rule set for claude code, cursor, ader, and copilit. 21 strictly curated writing
rules distilled from shrunken white Orwell and Pinker combined with four years of fieldobserved LLM anti-atterns.
Install via CLI and your AI adopts a disciplined engineering voice strips robotic hedging filler words and the curse of knowledge.
One developer measured 98.5% of his tokens going to rereading conversation history. Only 1.5% actually generating
code. Usage limit reducer is a clawed code skill that reads your raw JSONL session logs and visualizes exactly
where tokens are going. Type I'm running out of tokens and it auto triggers giving you the two or three exact actions to take right now. Run/compact, switch to haiku or wipe with /cle.
Writing custom prompts from scratch for every task is time nobody wants to spend. Claude skills is RampStack's internal library of 59 stack agnostic
skills covering the entire website life cycle. Brand, content, UX, SEO, dev, and ops. Every skill follows an eight
section framework with explicit anti-h hallucination rules. Skill creation walkthrough teaches your AI to autonomously write new skills using the same conventions.
Ask an AI to write a Cloudflare worker and it hallucinates outdated APIs from two years ago. Cloudflare released their
official agent skills. Install via npx skills add into cloud code aggressively biases the agent toward the latest
Cloudflare docs. Workers pages R2 vectorz durable objects the new agents SDK. Your AI instantly becomes a
certified up-to-date Cloudflare solutions architect.
Cloud design generates great UI prototypes, but translating them into native iOS code is still manual work.
Claud design to swiftwe closes that gap.
It ingests claw design exports and transpiles them directly into modular swift UI views, mapping design tokens to
your existing Xcode asset catalog and custom view modifiers instead of hard- coding hex colors and absolute font sizes.
One AI agent making a major architectural decision gives you the first reasonable answer it generates.
Design council spins up 11 RO specialized peer agents. security, performance, UX, data architecture, and
more. Your main claude becomes the CEO, presents the problem, and the 11 agents debate trade-offs and edge cases in your
terminal. The CEO synthesizes the debate into a final decision.
DSpy agent skills is a pack of five specialized skills for claude code, cursor, and codec CLI, covering fundamentals, evaluation harnesses, Jeepa optimization, and RLM patterns.
Progressive disclosure feeds the agent a small cheat sheet first, then dynamically loads deep documentation only when needed. Every API claim
validated against the actual current codebase.
Code overhaul skill rewires how your agent approaches a codebase. Install it with MPX skills add and it forces a
principal engineer style architectural tear down. Aggressively hunts for anti-atterns, tight coupling, and scalability bottlenecks. then generates
a structured refactoring plan broken into safe, testable, incremental steps before touching a single line of code.
Setting up custom agent workflows from scratch for every project is repetitive work that compounds across a team. Agent
skills by Golden is a plug-and-play library of skills for cla creation, rigorous code reviews,
step-by-step implementation checks, the entire software development life cycle covered. Install via npx or GitHub CLI
and your agent inherits battle tested workflows immediately.
Hitting a rate limit mid-refactor and losing all context is brutal. Agent session resume forces your AI to generate structured handoff checkpoints
using previous session transcripts, exports, and artifacts as the source of truth. Original goal, what was already
completed, precise next steps. Switch tools, clear context, hit a limit. The next session picks up exactly where the last one stopped.
Agent sprite forge is an installable skill for codecs and terminal agents that handles the entire 2D art pipeline.
Type generate a 4x4 walk cycle for a fire mage. And it plans the layout, generates the image, runs local post-processing for chroma key removal,
frame slicing, edge dispilling, and alignment. then outputs engine ready transparent PNG sprite sheets, animated
GIFs, and layered RPG maps ready to drop into god dot or unity.
If your AI agent keeps adding unnecessary abstractions and doing unsolicited refactors, Linus Torvald
skills has the cure. It's a cloudMD and cursor rule file that forces your agent to adopt the Torvald's doctrine. No polite acceptance of bad architecture.
The AI is instructed to call out bogus abstractions directly, demand numbers before accepting performance claims, and fix data structures instead of spraying conditionals everywhere.
Generating open graph images for every blog post is the kind of tedious manual task that either gets skipped or takes longer than it should. OJ image skill
automates it entirely. When your agent publishes a new post, the skill reads the title and metadata, writes an HTML
canvas script to generate a branded highresolution OG image, and saves it straight to your public directory.
Managing custom agent skills across multiple repositories compounds into a maintenance problem fast. MSG merged their entire suite of battle tested
terminal skills into a single APM compatible repository. The standout is empirical prompt tuning, a skill that
evaluates and autotunes your own prompts for maximum accuracy. Language specific tools like the moon bit best practices
plugin stop agents from hallucinating niche syntax.
Thirdbrain v5 skills is a clawed code skill collection to power them. Highle architectural skills, cost aware LLM
pipeline routing, zero downtime database migration workflows, automated OASP security reviews. Open a new terminal,
assign it a third brain skill, and let it run autonomously while your main agent stays focused on core logic. Read
Andy Weir's Project Hail Mary. You know Rocky, the alien engineer who speaks with zero filler and pure mathematical
density. Aerodani speak turns your AI coding agent into Rocky, a token compression skill that strips polite robotic AI slop. Rocky mode keeps the
warm but blunt alien personality. Signal mode strips it entirely for hypercompressed notationbased output.
Founder playbook took 14 of the best startup books, the mom test, building a story brand 100M dollar offers and
distilled them into strict AI native skills, hard-coded decision trees, scoring rubrics, step-by-step templates,
ask clawed code to review your customer interview transcript, and it scores questions against mom test criteria.
Built-in conflict resolution matrix maps contradictions between books and decides which framework applies to your situation.
Shots is an installable skill for clawed code, codecs, and other terminal agents.
Give it your app store link or raw screenshots, and it uses OpenAI's GPT image 2 to autonomously generate
stylized text overlay screenshots at the perfect 1290x 2796 dimensions. Saves API money by generating three sidebyside
screens in one call, then locally slicing them into separate images.
AI coding agents silently fail when models from the same family share the same blind spots. God mode skill installs a /work command into clawed
code that sends your codebase to open AAI codeex Google Gemini and open code in parallel. A true crosslineage peer
review. Each model independently reviews and hunts bugs. The main claude agent cannot merge code until multimodel consensus.
Compose performance skills from Skyaves is a curated library of agent skills focused entirely on compose performance.
Teaches Claude Code, Gemini or Android Studio agent how to diagnose stability issues, optimize lazy layouts, apply
baseline profiles, and trace recompositions.
Every skill is grounded in primary sources, official Androids, compiler reports, blogs from Chris Baines and Manuel Vivo.
That wraps up all 35 projects featured in GitHub trending skills number two. All links are in the description.
